original: My fever's coming down. And I feel\na lot better.
I couldn't find him anywhere\nnearby, but I've found this: cold\nmedicine!
Pretty sure Taichi must have\ngotten it for you and dropped it.
Medicine that Taichi had... so\ndoes that mean he's somewhere\naround here?
Seems like this place is a maze.\nIf we look for him together, I'm\nsure we'll find him.
I'll help you guys out! I'm his\nlittle sister, after all!
Quiet! I can hear voices coming\nfrom there!
Listen up, Numemon. This here\nmountain's the property of\nMugendramon.
And you all are the power source\nfor the greater urban area! So\nwork, work, work until you die!
What's going on? Flaking off now?
Tailmon, don't worry about me. We\nhave to free the Numemon.
What are we gonna do, Sora?
The only thing we can do is run!
Hey, you Numemon over there!\nWhaddya think you're doing?
You think you can defeat *me*, the\ngreat WaruMonzaemon?
Hah hah ha! It's the end for you!
I feel power coming from inside\nher...
Yeah, there's power overflowing\nfrom inside her body!
They'll be okay in no time flat!
The light is showing us the way...
If we keep following the light,\nmaybe we'll find Taichi and the\nothers!
Okay! We'll put our faith in your\nlight, Hikari.
Sora... I wonder how Yamato is\ndoing?
He wouldn't want you sad, Takeru.
Those two won't be taken down so\neasily.
I'm sure he'll come back when he\nfeels better.
I'm sure he's thinking of you,\nTakeru.
So have faith in him, okay?
You're right... Yamato's always\nthinking of me.
But this time, I'll be the one to\nlook after him!
